title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation
authors: J. Pennington, R. Socher, C. Manning
before: word2vec learned from local context windows, one sample at a time.
problem: Local windows ignore the global co-occurrence statistics of the whole corpus.
breakthrough: Factorise the global word co-occurrence matrix directly, giving vectors with a cleaner interpretation.
why: It gave the embedding idea a second, complementary derivation and became the default pretrained vectors for years.
next: Absorbed into ELMo and other models as an input layer.
inherits: Count-based and predictive embeddings as two views of the same geometry.
